result.title: Operon-S1: a fast decision controller for long-horizon biomedical agents
result.comment: 40 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables, 5 Extended Data figures, 6 Extended Data tables
result.summary: Language-model agents now carry out long scientific work in biology, but their judgements about conventions, skills, errors, evidence and stopping are made inside the reasoning that does the work, where they cannot be measured, replaced or improved on their own. Here we present Operon-S1, a fast decision system, a System 1 for the agent, that separates judging from doing. A decision harness poses the agent's recurring judgements as closed questions at 13 decision points and acts only through fixed messages that never contain an answer, so any model that answers the questions can serve as the judge. Across seven life-science benchmarks, a local decision model took over these judgements in 0.6 s at the median for an in-loop request on CPU at no request cost, with no measurable change in the agent's score on five of six benchmarks, whereas the general language model that drives the agent, asked the same questions, accounted for 8.0% to 35.2% of task cost. Every decision is recorded with its consequence. Retraining on labels from task construction, verifiers or execution raised decision accuracy on every question in each of three trained versions, and a new version enters service only through a promotion gate. Task-level results in this study use the public checkpoint. The same closed decisions serve wet-laboratory protocol troubleshooting and the design of a germline target enrichment panel. Like the regulator of an operon, which switches genes on and off without making their products, Operon-S1 steers the agent without doing its work, and makes the agent's judgements a layer that can be measured, replaced and trained.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Operon-S1，把长程生物医学 agent 中的判断与执行分离：在 13 个决策点以封闭问题形式交给本地小模型（CPU 中位 0.6 s、无请求费用）作答，仅通过不含答案的固定消息干预，并记录每次决策及其后果，再用任务构建、验证器或执行标签重训并以晋升门控上线。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「判断层外置」把停止、错误与证据判断变成可测量、可替换、可训练的独立模块，并逐决策核算成本，可能为 LVR 中 STOP 决策与贡献分配提供可供核查的轻量控制器思路；但工作为纯文本 agent 系统，未涉及视觉细节或 latent 状态。
